candidates.title: 'He lived and breathed it': NCAA football prospect from N.S. has died
candidates.description: A Nova Scotian who was set to play football at an American powerhouse college is being remembered for his exceptional talent and desire to get better on the field, but also his happy-go-lucky and teddy-bear nature off of it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney, Quebec premier discuss U.S. trade, homelessness at first meeting in Cambodia
candidates.description: Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said the meeting ended with federal support for the province's fight against homelessness, and the exchange of personal phone numbers. The premier also thanked the prime minister for his support of an economic summit that will take place in Quebec in 2027.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: It started with a lobster supper. Now it's an East Coast institution
candidates.description: The Shore Club in Hubbards, N.S., has spent more than eight decades serving up classic lobster suppers and live music to people from around the globe. A new CBC documentary pulls back the curtain on how the Harnish family managed to turn a rural dance hall into a Maritime institution.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: A man was once murdered over the pronunciation of 'Newfoundland'
candidates.description: Newfoundlanders and Labradorians tend to feel strongly about the right way to pronounce the name of our island, but would you kill a man over it? In 1876, someone did.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Fifth soldier dead from injuries suffered in CFB Wainwright fire, officials say
candidates.description: A fifth soldier, Pte. William Douglas Dal Bianco, has died as a result of the fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, the Department of National Defence says.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: A hobby that pops: Saskatoon man's massive Coca-Cola collection inspired by rural roots
candidates.description: Jon Aschenbrener of Saskatoon estimates he has 5,000 to 10,000 items in his collection of Coca-Cola memorabilia, which began on the family farm northeast of Cupar, Sask.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney cites her award-winning book on encampments. She's eyeing his plan to end homelessness
candidates.description: One of Canada's leading authors on homelessness says the prime minister’s plan to end it within 10 years is an "ambitious goal" that has potential, but won't actually go all the way.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: One person still missing after fishing boat capsized near Yale, B.C., search and rescue says
candidates.description: One person is still unaccounted for after a fishing boat reportedly capsized on the Fraser River in Yale, B.C., Friday afternoon. In a post to Facebook, Hope Volunteer Search and Rescue said the operation quickly turned into a search, after personnel were told there was another person in the water.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Premier says Manitoba nearing limits of what it can do on affordability, so he's going after big corporations
candidates.description: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says the provincial government is reaching the limits of what it can do to ease the cost of living without sacrificing the revenue needed to fund public services, and that corporate giants need to do their part.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Snowbirds set to fly iconic jets for last time this weekend
candidates.description: Fifty-five years after the team's formation, the Canadian Forces Snowbirds' iconic jets will grace the skies one last time. The aerobatics team's CT-114 Tutor jets are set to fly over Calgary's McMahon Stadium on Sunday as part of the 113th Grey Cup festivities, before being grounded permanently.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada's Dabrowski, Brazil's Stefani fall in doubles semifinals at WTA Finals
candidates.description: Canadian Gabriela Dabrowski's unbeaten run at the WTA Finals came to an end Saturday night as she and partner Luisa Stefani of Brazil were beaten in the doubles semifinals in Indian Wells, Calif.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Avian flu outbreak spreads to other provinces at national poultry show: CFIA
candidates.description: Avian flu has been detected in three flocks, including in Manitoba and Alberta, following an outbreak at a national poultry show in Saskatchewan earlier this month, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency has told CBC News.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Change to Ontario's 'safer-supply' opioid prescriptions abruptly paused due to legal challenge
candidates.description: A controversial change to "safer-supply" opioid prescriptions in Ontario that would force recipients to take them in front of a pharmacist, rather than on their own schedule at home, has been abruptly paused due to a legal challenge. Critics said the proposal would drastically affect the lives of drug users while causing potential chaos at pharmacies.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 3 kids, 2 adults in life-threatening condition after Burlington, Ont., house fire: police
candidates.description: Five people, including three children, are in life-threatening condition in hospital after a house fire in Burlington on Saturday morning, Halton police say.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Margaret Atwood joins other bird lovers to fight against a proposed 600-foot tower on Pelee Island
candidates.description: Atwood called the location, which is one road over from the new Atwood-Gibson Bird Centre, "one of the stupidest places on the planet" to put a tower.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: These farmers are worried N.L. is facing another hay shortage
candidates.description: Farmers and livestock owners are once again at risk of running out of hay following a disastrous shortage last year, according to some farmers. Demand for hay is growing each year and production can’t keep up, says the owners of 3C Farms in Comfort Cove-Newstead.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nova Scotia's MacDougall uses 5-point 8th end to win mixed curling nationals
candidates.description: Nova Scotia's Brent MacDougall is the Canadian mixed curling champion. The Nova Scotia rink, down 5-4 entering the eighth and final end, scored five to defeat New Brunswick's Sylvie Quillian 9-5 in Saturday's gold-medal final in Woodstock, P.E.I.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Scam targeting minor hockey teams 'heartbreaking' for affected kids
candidates.description: Valerie Favreau, the chair of the Oromocto Minor Hockey Association, said two under-13 teams signed up for a tournament in Stanley, with each team losing around $750 in fake registration fees. It's a type of scam that is referred to as "spear phishing," according to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebec assumes parents help pay for post-secondary schooling. Students say many can't
candidates.description: Thousands of post-secondary and university students held strikes across Quebec this week to denounce "austerity measures and growing precariousness" among students in the face of the rising cost of living and the provincewide housing crisis. Among other things, the coalition is calling for a reform of Quebec's student financial aid program.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump breaks silence on nationwide ground stop, demands more money for FAA infrastructure from Congress
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday broke his silence on the nationwide ground stop that snarled airline travel this weekend, using the incident to push Congress on money to fully upgrade America’s air traffic control system.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 3 months after mass entry, some 15,000 migrants remain in Ceuta
candidates.description: Three months after the mass entry into Ceuta, many migrants still hope the Spanish enclave will offer them a route to mainland Europe. Local authorities and residents are struggling with the surge.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Satellite limitations imposed by Musk's SpaceX pose danger for Ukraine, Zelenskyy says
candidates.description: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that limitations on the Starshield satellite system, operated by Elon Musk's SpaceX, could weaken defences around Ukraine's energy infrastructure ahead of the winter months, when Moscow has repeatedly targeted the power grid.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Facing 'uncomfortable' questions, King Charles shows the 'soft power' of the Crown
candidates.description: As with trips to Canada in 2025 and the United States earlier this year, King Charles's recent visit to the Caribbean saw him walking something of a diplomatic tightrope at a politically charged time. There seems to be an emerging pattern.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney pledges $560M to Brazil-led fund to protect rainforests
candidates.description: Canada has pledged up to $560 million over four years ​to protect rainforests as part of a project co-led by Brazil and Norway.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Senior Hamas commander who helped oversee Oct. 7 attack killed in Israeli strike in Gaza
candidates.description: Hamas said on Sunday that a senior commander who helped plan and oversee the Oct. 7, 2023, attack on Israel had been killed in an Israeli airstrike, with the Israeli military confirming his death.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: SpaceX Starship successfully re-docks at Texas launch pad after orbiting Earth
candidates.description: SpaceX's Starship made a triumphant return to Earth on Saturday, caught in midair by giant mechanical arms where its journey began 22 hours earlier. It's the first key recovery of the rocket system's centerpiece vessel in the company's decade-long effort to ‌develop a fully reusable rocket.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: New Orleans port sues for control of China-linked tanker that crashed into cruise ship
candidates.description: Just hours after a tanker in New Orleans lost its steering and slammed into a docked river cruise boat, the city's port sued to make sure federal investigators can seize the vessel that is owned by a subsidiary of a Chinese company.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: European security plan floated by U.S. would benefit Putin, Zelenskyy says
candidates.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the United States had raised the possibility of a new security framework for Europe as part of efforts to end Russia’s war in Ukraine, warning that Moscow could use such discussions to weaken NATO and reshape the continent’s borders.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney says he will not boycott APEC 'family photo' with Putin
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he will participate in an upcoming group photo with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit out of respect for the host, Chinese President Xi Jinping.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian judge decries U.S. sanctions of International Criminal Court as 'attack in favour of impunity'
candidates.description: Kimberly Prost, a Canadian judge at the International Criminal Court, was sanctioned by the Trump administration last August. Despite impacts including cancelled credit cards and frozen bank accounts, she says attempts to intimidate her and other court officials are 'futile.'
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Miracle on the Mississippi': All aboard river cruise boat survive crash with tanker in New Orleans
candidates.description: A tanker in New Orleans that apparently lost its steering slammed into a docked river cruise boat with 180 people aboard Friday, the mayor said. All aboard survived after the crash prompted a massive rescue operation for passengers and crew who plunged into the Mississippi River as the ship took on water and began to topple over.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Microsoft services fully restored after global outage
candidates.description: Microsoft said on Saturday that services had fully recovered across Teams, Outlook and its other products, ending a global outage that crippled online communications ‌for businesses and governments for over 24 hours.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: UN hails progress in Ebola response, cites insecurity as biggest challenge
candidates.description: UN health officials on Friday hailed progress in the Ebola response six months after the ​outbreak first prompted global concerns, but cautioned that ‌the disease continues to spread to more remote and dangerous parts of Congo.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Spanish goalkeeper barred 12 games for collision leading to death of Tenerife striker
candidates.description: While Spain mourns the death of a soccer player who suffered a cardiac arrest after an on-field collision, the emergency medical treatment he received is falling under scrutiny.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. Treasury Secretary frustrated by Commerce Department's inaction on Nvidia chips
candidates.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he was frustrated with the Commerce Department's delay in placing restrictions on Nvidia chip exports to a company led by an alleged Chinese spy.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Minimum wage hasn't kept pace with the cost of living across Canada, new reports show
candidates.description: Of the 59 cities and regions in reports for every province reviewed by CBC News, none had a provincial minimum wage equal to the calculated living wage — the amount a full-time worker needs to meet their basic needs, manage unexpected expenses and participate meaningfully in their community.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: TV providers say Rogers' Monday hockey move inflates prices, 'erodes' sports viewing
candidates.description: A trio of television providers are accusing Rogers Communications Inc. of violating competition rules and inflating Canadian sports fans' bills by moving Monday night hockey broadcasts exclusively to its Sportsnet Plus streaming service for this NHL season.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
candidates.description: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Pope Leo rides in helicopter cockpit during Peru trip
candidates.description: The Pope took to the skies before arriving in Cusco on the penultimate day of his Latin America tour.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
candidates.description: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
candidates.description: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Judge blocks Trump closure of 'Trash Island' Washington DC golf course on Sunday
candidates.description: The temporary order is part of a months-long challenge to the US president's plans to upgrade East Potomac Golf Links into a championship course.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ronaldinho makes comeback in Ravenna win
candidates.description: Brazil legend Ronaldinho makes his comeback aged 46 for Ravenna, playing the first half of their Italian third-tier derby against Forli.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: Cruise ship overturns after collision with tanker in New Orleans
candidates.description: Around 130 people were rescued from a cruise ship after it was struck by a tanker while docked in New Orleans, Louisiana on Friday.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Judo champion shakes up French presidential race with surprise candidacy
candidates.description: Teddy Riner is one of the most popular figures in modern-day France, and one in five voters say they could support him.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
candidates.description: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
candidates.description: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: How the Jensen Huang scandal created a headache for business-friendly Singapore
candidates.description: The scandal has cast a spotlight on Singapore's success as a chip hub - and a location for alleged illicit trade.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Bluetongue virus confirmed on County Down farm
candidates.description: Officials from the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs said the virus had been detected in three sheep.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
candidates.description: Chile's far-right President José Antonio Kast is facing mounting public anger, as rising fuel prices trigger transport strikes and protests across the country.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Commerce Department under pressure for delaying export controls on Nvidia chips
candidates.description: The U.S. Commerce Department is under scrutiny for clearing Chinese companies to handle Nvidia chips, despite national security concerns from cabinet officials and U.S. intelligence agencies.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: These economists say in-person work boosts creativity, but office mandates fall short
candidates.description: A pair economists argue in a new book that people are more creative and productive when they work together in person. But it's not enough for employers to simply order workers back to the office.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
candidates.description: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Laws limiting coal miners' exposure to toxic dust are in danger of being rolled back
candidates.description: Coal miners who are exposed to silica dust are at a higher risk of black lung disease. Despite decades of advocacy, new efforts to regulate the toxic dust are under threat.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: A new generation of disability rights activists carry on Judy Heumann's legacy
candidates.description: The film Being Heumann tells the lesser-known story of the mother of the disability rights movement. A new generation of activists share how they "carry the torch" today.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
candidates.description: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: A new policy could help solve the U.S. organ shortage. Critics say it's unethical
candidates.description: New guidelines are supposed to protect organ donors in a retrieval procedure that keeps blood flowing through livers, kidneys, lungs and hearts. But bioethicists have troubling questions.
candidates.author: NPR
